seo.title: Your Company — beauty salon and cosmetology in Tashkent
seo.description: Facials, cleansing and peels, manicure, brows and lashes, massage at Your Company on Mirabad. Sterile tools, online booking, open daily 9:00–21:00.
seo.answer: Your Company is a beauty salon at 18 Mirabad St in Tashkent: facials and cleansing from 350,000 UZS, manicure with polish from 180,000 UZS, brows and lashes from 150,000 UZS, massage from 300,000 UZS. Open daily 9:00–21:00, book by phone +998 71 200-00-41 or on Telegram.

sections.title: Skin you want to touch
sections.subtitle: Facials, manicure, brows and massage in one light-filled space. Come for an hour — leave rested.

sections.label: The salon
sections.title: Beauty without the rush
sections.text: Your Company is a small six-chair salon. We never book back to back: there are twenty minutes between guests for cleaning and sterilisation. We use professional skincare; before a treatment the cosmetologist looks at your skin and chooses the right care rather than selling a course. Tea, quiet and soft light come as standard.

sections.label: Prices
sections.title: Services and prices
sections.intro: Prices per treatment. The cosmetologist will quote a course after a consultation — it’s free.

items.a: By phone +998 71 200-00-41 or on Telegram @bloombeautybar. We confirm your booking by message the day before.

items.q: Are there contraindications for cleansing and peels?
items.a: Yes: active inflammation, a fresh tan, pregnancy for some acids, isotretinoin treatment. The cosmetologist will ask about this at the consultation and suggest gentle care if in doubt.
Metal tools go through disinfection, ultrasonic cleaning and a dry-heat steriliser; the kraft pouch is opened in front of you. Files and buffers are single-use.

items.q: Can I buy a gift certificate?
items.a: Yes, for any amount from 300,000 UZS or for a specific treatment. A certificate is valid for 6 months; we issue it at the salon or send an electronic one.

items.q: How long does a facial cleansing take?
items.a: About 75 minutes including the mask. Redness usually goes within a few hours, so it’s better to plan important meetings for the next day.
Let us know: if you are more than 15 minutes late, the treatment may need to be shortened or moved so the next guest isn’t kept waiting.
